sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all weather road. The nearest Railway Station is Contai which is approx. 24 Km from Dariapur Lighthouse and nearest Airport is Kolkata which is approx. 200 km from Lighthouse.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text: Branch Post Office, High School, Hospital and Police Station all are within 22 km from Lighthouse.
